title: Queryfirst query meta (version 1)
description: Contract between the Queryfirst core, generators, `qf test` and third-party generators. One file `foo.qf.json` is committed next to each query file `foo.sql`/`foo.psql`. It holds nothing environment-specific (no OIDs, host, database or server version). Keys are written in the order documented here; optional keys are omitted when absent.

version.description: Meta format version. Readers must reject a larger value (written by a newer Queryfirst).

source.description: POSIX-style, project-relative path of the query file.

name.description: Query name (from @name or derived from the file name). Generators derive identifiers from it.

description.description: Free-text description from the query header, if any.

sqlHash.description: sha256 of the query file after normalising line endings to LF. Used to detect stale meta.

provider.description: Database provider the query was analysed against.

params.description: Parameters in pgtyped order: @param declarations first, then the others by first use.

columns.description: Result columns in order. Empty for statements returning no rows.

generated.description: Files generated from this meta, with content hashes.

source.description: Query body exactly as pgtyped's `statement` field: header removed, trailing `;` and surrounding whitespace removed, `:name` markers kept. `locs` index into this string.

db.description: Query body with `$n` placeholders, as sent to PostgreSQL.

name.description: Parameter name as written after `:` in the query.

dbIndex.description: 1-based `$n` indexes this parameter maps to. Empty for pick/spread transforms (see transform keys).

required.description: Whether the parameter is non-nullable in generated code.

requiredReason.description: Why `required` has its value: explicit annotation, inferred from a NOT NULL insert target, inferred from an equality against a NOT NULL column in WHERE, or the nullable default.

locs.description: Every occurrence of the parameter in `statement.source`.

transform.description: How the parameter expands in the SQL (pgtyped-compatible).

type.description: An array expanded into a list of values: `(:ids...)`.
One object expanded into a tuple: `(:p(a, b))`.
An array of objects expanded into a list of tuples: `(:p(a, b)...)`.

required.description: Whether the property is non-nullable (`!` suffix).

name.description: Result column name, with any type-override suffix stripped.

nullable.description: Whether the value can be NULL.

nullableReason.description: Why `nullable` has its value: proven non-null by the analyser, made nullable by an outer join, an expression the analyser treats as nullable, the analyser gave up (conservatively nullable), or forced by an explicit override.

columnSource.description: Table column a result column was traced to. Omitted for computed columns.

name.description: PostgreSQL type name (typname), e.g. `int4`, `accessLevel`. Element type when `array` is true.

array.description: True when the value is an array of `name`.

modifier.description: Type modifier text such as `(12,2)` or `(30)`. Omitted when none.

enumValues.description: Enum labels, sorted. Present only when category is `enum`.

typeOverride.description: A user-chosen target type from a @type annotation or column suffix.

name.description: Type name to use in generated code.

module.description: Module to import the type from, if any.

array.description: True when the override is an array of `name`.

loc.description: Interval in UTF-16 code units of `statement.source`, both ends inclusive (as pgtyped).

a.description: First UTF-16 unit of the `:name` marker.

b.description: Last UTF-16 unit of the marker (inclusive).

state.description: The query could not be analysed; params and columns may be incomplete. Generators must not emit code.

col.description: 1-based column (in characters) in the query file.

path.description: POSIX-style, project-relative path of a generated file.

hash.description: sha256 of the generated file content.
